3b667fdfffce81ef.job_title: Physician (MD/DO) - Put Medical AI to the Test, Remote
3b667fdfffce81ef.description: About the company Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. This is a task-based, independent contractor opportunity, not an employment relationship. Participation is limited to this project. Project Highlights Earnings per approved task: a fixed rate for each task, set in advance Fully self-scheduled: no minimum hours and no set schedule; you choose which tasks to take and when Remote: open to US-licensed physicians based in eligible US states No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases All contributors are license-verified physicians $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved What this project involves We're looking for physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. Each task is a written clinical case, assessed against the project's acceptance criteria. Contributors may: Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor "trap" answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems; Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality; Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales. Each case receives three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You're improving the AI tools you'll eventually use yourself. What we look for This project is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around their other commitments. Ideally, contributors will have: Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly); Board certification or completed residency training, with direct patient care experience (attending-level preferred). Practising or retired physicians welcome; Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine); Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines; Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus); Strong written English (C1+). This project is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles. How it works Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join the project → Complete tasks → Get paid for approved tasks Flexibility You decide whether, when, and how much to contribute. There are no minimum hours, set schedules, or required availability. Task availability varies with project phases. Tasks are submitted through the platform and are approved when they meet the project’s acceptance criteria. Earnings Earnings are paid only for completed and approved tasks. Each task type has a fixed rate. There is no time tracking and no hour logging. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the rate. QA and adjudication tasks have a higher per-task rate. $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first task on the project is approved. Quality incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks, on terms set out in the project guidelines.

0-1 سنة، العمل بدوام كامل في مدن مثل الدمام، الخبر، الظهران، الجبيل، الأحساء، القطيف، بقيق، راس تنورة، صفوى، الجش، عنك، دارين، العمران، المبرز، والجفر. يركز الدور على تقديم المنتجات والخدمات المصرفية للعملاء بمستوى عالٍ من الجودة والاحترافية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية يتولى استشاري المبيعات مجموعة من المهام الأساسية التي تضمن سير العمليات المصرفية بسلاسة وفعالية، مع التركيز على خدمة العملاء وتلبية احتياجاتهم. تشمل هذه المهام ما يلي: استقبال طلبات بيع المنتجات المصرفية ومتابعة إدخالها وتنفيذها على الأنظمة المخصصة. مساعدة العملاء في فتح الحسابات، استيفاء المستندات المطلوبة، إدخال البيانات والتوقيعات في النظام، وطلب تعميد مدير العمليات. ترحيل العقود والحسابات عبر البريد إلى مركز المعلومات وعلى نظام إدارة المستندات (DMS). استقبال العملاء في الفرع وتقديم الخدمة المطلوبة، مع توجيههم لإتمام معاملاتهم بشكل صحيح. مساعدة العملاء في تعبئة النماذج اللازمة وتوجيههم لاستخدام أجهزة الصراف الآلي والقنوات الإلكترونية. الاستجابة السريعة لمشاكل العملاء وتلبية طلباتهم وفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة، والمتابعة مع مراقب الفرع لحل المشكلات. استلام طلبات بطاقات الصراف الآلي، إدخالها في النظام، طباعة البطاقات الفورية، وتسليم البطاقات المجددة. استقبال طلبات تحديث البيانات، قفل الحسابات، وتعديل بيانات الحسابات وتسليمها لمدير العمليات. التعامل مع العملاء الموكلين، استكمال بيانات نماذج التوكيل، مطابقة التوقيعات، وإدخالها في النظام. استيفاء الأوامر المستديمة للعملاء، إنشاء وتنشيط العضويات، وتحويلها لمدير العمليات لاستكمال التنفيذ. التعامل مع طلبات تغيير التوقيع وتحريك الحسابات. إدخال المطالبات المتعلقة بالصراف الآلي ونقاط البيع في نظام مطالبات بطاقات الصراف الآلي. تحويل مشاكل العملاء إلى مدير العمليات للعمل على حلها. الاستعلام عن البطاقات الائتمانية وبطاقات الصراف الآلي المسحوبة في الفرع وتوجيه العملاء لاستلامها. تزويد العملاء بمنشورات المنتجات المصرفية. رفع بلاغات الاشتباه في غسل الأموال وحالات الاحتيال، والإبلاغ عن أي حالات مخالفة للأنظمة والتعليمات. المؤهلات والخبرات يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحين يمتلكون المهارات الأساسية لخدمة العملاء والتعامل مع العمليات المصرفية. يجب أن تتوافر في المتقدمين المؤهلات التالية: خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على التعامل مع أنظمة إدخال البيانات المصرفية. مهارات تواصل ممتازة لتقديم خدمة عملاء احترافية. الالتزام بالدقة والاحترافية في إنجاز المهام. بيئة العمل يُعد هذا الدور وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق مصرف الراجحي في المنطقة الشرقية، مما يوفر بيئة عمل داعمة ومحفزة لتطوير المهارات المصرفية وخدمة العملاء. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقدم لهذه الفرصة في مصرف الراجحي.

3b934fc259c003ca.description: About the Role Swissport KSA is seeking an Aircraft Push Back Driver to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves the safe and efficient operation of aircraft pushback tractors and towing equipment, ensuring compliance with Swissport operational procedures, airline requirements, airport regulations, and aviation safety standards. The position is critical for maintaining safe aircraft movement and operational punctuality. Key Responsibilities Perform safe aircraft pushback and towing operations using authorized ground support equipment (GSE). Follow approved aircraft pushback procedures and instructions from ground communication personnel. Ensure correct connection and disconnection of tow bars or towbarless tractors. Maintain safe clearance from aircraft, vehicles, equipment, and airport infrastructure. Support on-time aircraft departures while adhering to safety standards. Comply with Swissport Ground Operations Manual (GOM), IATA standards, and GACA regulations. Conduct pre-operational safety inspections of pushback tractors and related equipment. Report equipment defects, safety hazards, incidents, and near misses immediately. Follow airside driving regulations, speed limits, and designated operating routes. Stop operations immediately if an unsafe condition is identified. Operate only equipment for which training and authorization have been received. Ensure equipment serviceability before and after each operation. Report equipment damage or mechanical defects to the responsible supervisor. Maintain cleanliness and proper handling of assigned GSE. Coordinate with ramp teams, headset operators, wing walkers, and other authorized personnel. Follow instructions from the Ramp Supervisor and designated aircraft movement personnel. Maintain clear communication throughout pushback operations. Assist with other ramp-related duties when assigned, provided appropriate training and authorization are in place. Authority and Accountability The Aircraft Push Back Driver is responsible for the safe operation of assigned pushback equipment and has the authority to stop any operation when safety is compromised. It is mandatory that aircraft pushback or towing operations are not performed without the required training, equipment authorization, applicable permits, and operational clearance. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of relevant experience. Ability to operate aircraft pushback tractors and towing equipment safely and efficiently. Knowledge of aviation safety standards and ground handling procedures. Strong commitment to safety and compliance. Working Conditions This position requires working within active airport ramp environments. This includes exposure to aircraft noise, moving equipment, high temperatures, varying weather conditions, and shift-based operational demands. Appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) must be worn at all times in accordance with Swissport requirements. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply for this full-time role in Jeddah, Makkah. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

3ba31217f3e4ffd8.description: About the Role Parsons Corporation is seeking a Senior Project Quality Specialist (Mechanical & Plumbing) to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves supporting quality assurance, inspection, testing, and compliance activities for mechanical, plumbing, firefighting, fire protection, and FLS systems within a major Airport Infrastructure Project. The Senior Project Quality Specialist will provide technical quality oversight across construction, testing, commissioning, and handover phases, coordinating with contractors, consultants, and project stakeholders. Experience and certification in welding inspection for carbon steel and iron ductile pipe systems are considered an advantage, though candidates without this experience remain eligible. Key Responsibilities Support the implementation of project quality requirements for mechanical, plumbing, firefighting, fire protection, and FLS systems. Review and monitor contractor compliance with Quality Management Plans, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), method statements, material submittals, shop drawings, and NFPA requirements. Ensure installations adhere to project specifications, approved designs, manufacturer recommendations, and applicable international codes and standards. Review and witness welding and jointing inspection activities for carbon steel, ductile iron, and HDPE piping, including fusion processes, operator qualifications, traceability, and test records. Conduct inspections and quality surveillance for HVAC systems, chilled water systems, pumps, ventilation systems, mechanical plant rooms, and building services equipment. Monitor quality compliance for potable water, drainage, sewerage, stormwater, hot and cold-water distribution, water treatment, and sanitary systems. Conduct quality surveillance of firefighting and fire protection systems, including piping, pumps, valves, suppression systems, testing, commissioning, and FLS interfaces. Review and witness pressure testing, hydrostatic testing, flushing, cleaning, equipment testing, HVAC performance testing, balancing, commissioning, and associated records. Monitor contractor and subcontractor quality performance, conduct site inspections and audits, identify quality risks, and verify corrective and preventive action closure. 3bf78ff290962e0a.description: The Senior Network Engineer is responsible for leading and executing enterprise-wide migration initiatives from public to private IP addressing across applications, databases, servers, and network devices. This role ensures secure, resilient, and uninterrupted service delivery through careful planning, dependency analysis, execution, validation, and documentation of network changes in complex on-premises, cloud, or hybrid environments. Key Responsibilities • Conduct a comprehensive assessment of all servers, applications, databases, and network devices currently using public IP addresses. • Develop a detailed IP migration plan covering timelines, phased execution, backup strategies, and service rollback procedures when required. • Perform application and service dependency analysis to identify and mitigate the impact of IP address migration on interconnected systems. • Design and allocate new private IP address ranges, ensuring full compatibility with the existing network architecture and infrastructure standards. • Execute the migration from public to private IP addresses in a secure and controlled manner, while maintaining continuous operation of business-critical applications and services. • Coordinate with security, systems, application, and operations teams to align firewall rules, routing, NAT, DNS, and access controls with the new private addressing model. • Perform post-migration validation and testing to confirm service availability, performance, and network stability. • Prepare and maintain comprehensive documentation for all migration phases, including implemented changes, encountered issues, root causes, and applied solutions. • Assess and analyze all DNS records to identify unused, obsolete, or outdated entries. • Classify DNS records based on criticality, activity level, and operational validity. • Remove or update invalid, obsolete, or unnecessary DNS entries in accordance with approved change procedures. • Ensure that DNS cleanup activities do not impact applications, services, or end users. • Establish periodic review procedures to maintain the accuracy and health of DNS records on an ongoing basis. • Document all DNS review, cleanup activities, and applied changes for audit, compliance, and operational reference. • Strong expertise in enterprise network design, IP addressing (IPv4/IPv6), subnetting, and routing protocols. • Hands-on experience with IP address migration projects in large-scale environments (on-prem, cloud, or hybrid). • Solid knowledge of firewalls, load balancers, DNS, NAT, VPNs, and network security controls. • Experience working with high-availability and mission-critical environments, ensuring zero or minimal downtime. • Ability to analyze complex application-to-network dependencies. • Familiarity with change management, rollback planning, and disaster recovery practices. • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field • Relevant certifications such as CCNP/CCIE, JNCIP/JNCIE,
